product.title: Boulder Joyride Guided eBike Tour

description.text: Ride Boulder on a guided e-bike route that mixes creek paths, neighborhood streets, and canyon-edge byways for a local's view of the city. Stops include Boulder Creek Path, Scott Carpenter Park, The Boulder Dushanbe Teahouse, Eben G. Fine Park, Boulder Canyon Trail. The outing covers eclectic neighborhoods, popular gathering spots, and open foothills views while your guide handles pacing and route choices. Ideal for visitors basing in Boulder who want a guided Front Range experience without coordinating meeting points, trailheads, or photo locations on their own.
